intro: A masterpiece in water purification, designed for those who seek elegance, durability, and advanced technology in one seamless experience. Crafted with SS Grade 304 Stainless Steel, Silk stands strong with an anti-corrosive, tough, and durable build—ensuring longevity like never before. Stay informed with an interactive LED display that offers real-time purification insights at a glance with 8 stages of advanced purification, Silk effortlessly removes impurities, purifies up to 3000 TDS, and ensures every drop is rich in minerals. Certified for excellence—Silk features NSF, WPS, and RoHS-certified filtration, ensuring international standards of purity and safety. With duo-sealing protection, your water remains untouched, untainted, and unbelievably fresh. Designed for your convenience, Silk boasts a long filter life—purifying up to 7200 liters without compromise. Experience the future of water purification. Silk – Timeless Purity. Enduring Strength.
